Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Opulence Rug, 8' x 10', Burgundy
Colors: Burgundy
Materials: stone
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Cotton Imported Get the look of classic opulence with modern durability in this Oriental-style rug. Its rich burgundy tones highlight an intricate geometric border that frames a traditional medallion pattern, finished with fringe for a timeless look. Traditional design with contemporary functionality Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene Exceptionally durable for busy households 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
